newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: C.BANK DECIDES REPO AUCTION TIMETABLE.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK DECIDES REPO AUCTION TIMETABLE.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Thursday that it has decided on a timetable for repo auctions for July to September.
"The Bank of Lithuania decided to held one repo auction per month in July, August and September," Gitanas Nauseda, head of the central bank's policy department told Reuters.
"The auctions will be held on the eighth of every month and the terms for each will be specified two days in advance," Nauseda added.

The Bank of Lithuania launched its first repo auction two weeks ago in a move to regain some of the functions of a central bank, of which it was stripped in 1994 when the country adopted a currency board model.
One bank took part in the first repo auction and a deal of 300,000 litas was registered.
The second repo auction held by central bank last week attracted little attention and no bids were registered.
"We will hold no more repo auctions in June," Nauseda said.
